rule_statement: Earlier draft superseded by the formal aggregation field type.
description: Coverage row: deprecated rule retained for audit.
name: deprecated:-ad-hoc-aggregations

rule_statement: The rulebook describes what the paper proves; it does not attempt to derive new mathematical content. Calculated fields surface relationships already present in the data.
name: describe,-do-not-derive

rule_statement: Hypothetical: allow non-source rows when prefixed `hypothetical-`. Under discussion.
description: Coverage row: rule not yet binding.
name: experimental-augment-policy-(under-discussion)

rule_statement: A rulebook is only valid when it compiles to at least two structurally-different substrates and produces field-for-field identical outputs against the same input data, gated by an answer-key.
name: gate-on-multi-substrate-parity

rule_statement: Every named mathematical object in the source papers must appear as a row in the rulebook before the rulebook can claim to mirror the result.
name: load-what-is-named

rule_statement: Columns that track the modeler's certainty (GapStatus, candidate, partial_candidate, …) are rejected at the storage layer. Curation notes live in commit messages, not in row data.
name: no-epistemic-state-columns

rule_statement: Modeler-added objects are allowed only with OriginatedHere=true. Speculative intermediates that are not in the source are rejected.
name: no-invented-intermediates
